title: FAO Transboundary Knowledge Portal
shortDescription: Conceptualized, designed, and launched the FAO Transboundary Plant Pests and Diseases digital knowledge portal, structuring geospatial surveillance telemetry, emergency response guidelines, and technical publications.
mandateChallenge: Consolidate dispersed regional pest monitoring protocols, early warning bulletins, and emergency response frameworks into a single authoritative digital hub for ministries of agriculture and field specialists.
executionCraft: Architected modern responsive portal layouts with structured content types, interactive knowledge taxonomy, video tutorials, and download repositories optimized for low-bandwidth field access.
impactMetric: Official FAO Global Knowledge Repository · Surveillance & SOPs
